svg.aria-label: Trait workflow: remote sensing to ecological forecasting
svg.title: Hindcast traits → Infer mixtures → Trait Driver Theory
svg.desc: Editable layered SVG for Affinity Designer / Canva. Groups are named by layer.

g.text: with multispectral imagery and recent imaging spectroscopy
Annual maps of community mean traits (1984 – present – 2050)
Community mean traits (per pixel, per year)
Inferred species mixture (relative abundances at each pixel)
Community trait distributions through time (at each pixel)
Test mechanisms and forecast ecosystem reorganization
Trait optima shift under climate change
Affinity tips: Ungroup as needed; all text is live text; charts are paths/rects; trait colors are set per-shape fill.
